sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the worked timber of posts, planks, benches and market stall frames in a quiet alien village: long grain strokes along each plank, a few knots, split ends, nail holes and dark iron straps, sun-bleached tops and darker undersides, planks of slightly different tones, one painted plank with flaking pastel paint. Three panels side by side: a large square-on swatch of planks and a post; a market stall and a bench of this timber seen from a walker's height with a small figure for scale; a strip showing the marks simplifying with distance, planks staying, grain and knots gone far. Calm, flat colour dominant, marks sparse and fine. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, warm ochre, grey-brown, bleached cream and one faded teal, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
